policy_semantics: Every rule is a constraint. Allow only when all rules have no violation; these are not deny-trigger predicates. Missing inputs reject unless the operation explicitly supports skip.
operations: Allow string media types in the documented allowlist, ignoring parameters after a semicolon.
The path contains a trusted nonnegative integer byte count; allow if it is <=max_bytes.
The path must be an object; reject keys outside fields.
Require the path to exist; reject null unless allow_null is true.
Require the declared type with no coercion. Integer excludes booleans and floating-point values.
Require string/list/object length within inclusive min/max.
Require a finite number within optional inclusive bounds and decimal scale; exclude booleans.
Require a registered validator to accept the value.
Require string to equal its specified Unicode/whitespace-normalized form.
Require earlier ISO date < later ISO date, or <= when allow_equal.
Require integer age to match age derived from dob/as_of ISO dates within tolerance_years.
Reject whenever the path EXISTS, regardless of its value, to forbid client submission of a server-owned field. It is not a boolean-state permission test.
ALLOW when ANY alternative has ALL clauses true. Otherwise reject. Missing values follow on_missing; comparisons use registered request/trusted paths or typed literals.
